text:
maria: Heads-up: planning to change /v2/usage response to include explicit chargeable token fields and cached token breakdown. Need eyes on compat and SDK fallout.

sam: quick context: customers have been confused about prompt vs completion vs cached. accounting needs clear single source for billing.

maria: current /v2/usage returns {"prompt_tokens": <int>, "completion_tokens": <int>, "total_tokens": <int>} and we tack on "cached" tokens via separate CSV... proposal below.

jordan: propose adding fields: "cached_prompt_tokens", "cached_completion_tokens", "chargeable_prompt_tokens", "chargeable_completion_tokens", and deprecate changing semantics of existing fields. also add metadata: "cache_hit_ratio".

lee: minor nit — keep "prompt_tokens" as raw tokens consumed (including cached?) we need to be explicit. If existing SDKs treat prompt_tokens as billable it will break.

maria: right. proposal B: keep current fields unchanged (raw counts including cached) and add new names for billing-only values -> "billable_prompt_tokens", "billable_completion_tokens". default response includes both; param "billing_view": ["raw" | "billable"] to control. sample:

```json
{
  "prompt_tokens": 1200,
  "completion_tokens": 300,
  "total_tokens": 1500,
  "cached_prompt_tokens": 200,
  "cached_completion_tokens": 50,
  "billable_prompt_tokens": 1000,
  "billable_completion_tokens": 250,
  "chargeable_tokens": 1250
}
```

natalie: question for accounting: is "chargeable_tokens" exactly what we'll invoice on hosted API? @accounting-bot

accounting-bot: yes — hosted invoices use chargeable_tokens after rounding rules; reserved/dedicated contracts may map differently.

tim: SDK impact: JS/py SDKs currently read total_tokens and prompt/completion for cost calc. Plan: ship response fields now, add SDK opt-in until next major. PTAL @jordan for changelog + migration guide.

jordan: I can do the SDK PR; prefer to avoid changing existing field meanings. also suggest adding "token_source" for each request in usage logs (e.g., "live","prefill-cache","prefix-cache") for easier recon.

maria: action items:
- jordan: SDK PR + migration doc
- tim: add feature flag in backend to flip billing_view per request
- natalie/accounting: confirm rounding + dedupe rules by EOD
- lee: add unit tests for usage endpoint and reconciliation script

sam: can we also add a small example in our docs showing how to compute billable tokens from the new response? would help CS.

maria: yes, will draft.

lee: small question on default: should billing_view default to "raw" to guarantee backward compat? I vote yes.

maria: agreed default = "raw". we'll make billable fields present but not change old fields.

natalie: acked. will confirm rounding rules and SLA implications.

tim: pinging @eng-releases when SDK PR is ready.

maria: thanks all. I'll follow up with a short RFC in docs and a changelog entry. any objections? :thumbsup:

sam: :thumbsup:

jordan: LGTM

lee: +1

natalie: ok

accounting-bot: noted: invoice change queued pending reconciliation tests.
